adjudication.rationale: The migration `20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb` copies the old `site_settings.embeddable_hosts` entries into the new `embeddable_hosts` table via raw SQL (`INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) without applying the model’s `before_validation` normalization that strips `http(s)://` and paths (`EmbeddableHost` does `sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')` and `sub!(/\/.*$/, '')`). Later, host checks use `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`, which parses the referer URL and compares `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` against the normalized hostname only. If an upgraded site previously stored entries like `http://example.com` or `example.com/blog` (which the removed `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` tolerated by stripping), the migrated row would not match and embedding would fail until corrected.
